post.description:
Get details, variants and availability for a product_id returned by search or lookup. Optional selected options refine the variant. Does not create a cart or place an order.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0005 USD (not a fixed price). Declared unit rate: $0.0001 USD per provider_credit. Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

product_id.description: Paste one product ID returned by search or lookup in the same catalog.

country.description: Buyer's two-letter country code, such as US, CA or GB, for localized results.

currency.description: Three-letter currency code, such as USD, CAD or GBP.

language.description: Preferred language tag, such as en or en-US.

region.description: Buyer's state, province or region, such as CA.

postal_code.description: Buyer's postal or ZIP code for localized results.

intent.description: Optional shopping preferences or intended use.

filters.description: Advanced filters, such as {"available":true,"price":{"max":15000}}. Price amounts use minor currency units: 15000 means USD 150.

preferences.description: Optional preferences to help select a variant.

view.description: Advanced Shopify output view. Leave empty for the default representation.

200.description:
Product records, product metadata and optional messages. Search includes pagination.cursor/has_next_page; repeat the original query with the returned cursor.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `product` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | Shopify product identifier; use unchanged for lookup or get_product. |
| `title` | string |  |
| `description` | object | May be inferred by Shopify; not necessarily merchant-authored. |
| `price_range` | object | Amounts in minor currency units, with currency codes. |
| `variants` | object[] |  |
| `media` | object[] |  |
| `rating` | object | Aggregate product rating, when available. |
| `options` | object[] | Product options and their available values. |
| `metadata` | object | Shopify catalog extension metadata, when available. |
| `selected` | object[] | Effective product option selections. |

post.description:
Search products across Shopify merchants by query, such as trail running shoes under $150. Narrow results by country and use limit and cursor to page through them. Results are estimates, not an exhaustive merchant inventory.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0005 USD (not a fixed price). Declared unit rate: $0.0001 USD per provider_credit. Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

query.description: What are you looking for? For example: `trail running shoes`. Required unless using like for similarity search.

country.description: Buyer's two-letter country code, such as US, CA or GB, for localized results.

limit.description:
Number of products per page, from 1 to 50. Shopify defaults to 10.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 50.

currency.description: Three-letter currency code, such as USD, CAD or GBP.

language.description: Preferred language tag, such as en or en-US.

cursor.description: For the next page, paste pagination.cursor from the previous response and keep the same search and filters.

region.description: Buyer's state, province or region, such as CA.

postal_code.description: Buyer's postal or ZIP code for localized results.

intent.description: Optional shopping preferences or intended use.

filters.description: Advanced filters, such as {"available":true,"price":{"max":15000}}. Price amounts use minor currency units: 15000 means USD 150.

like.description:
Advanced similarity search instead of, or alongside, query. Provide up to two items as {"id":"gid://shopify/..."} or {"image":{"content_type":"image/jpeg","data":"<base64>"}}.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 2.

catalog_id.description: Optional saved Shopify catalog ID to restrict the search.

view.description: Advanced Shopify output view. Leave empty for the default representation.
